summary: Iteration 43: Admin MANAGE-curated-accounts endpoints + UI validated end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass (list/edit/sage-reels/edit-reel/delete-reel incl. super-admin gating, 404s, data persistence, posts_count +/-). Web: /admin/curate 'Manage curated accounts' section lists accounts, dialog opens on row click, profile name+category edit via curated-edit-save persists, Sage AI (curated-sage-count=2 → curated-sage-add) added 2 Pixabay clips as reel rows, caption edit on blur persists, reel delete removes reel + decrements posts_count. Pixabay integration confirmed live (captions include 'royalty-free'). Cleanup: 2 leftover curated accounts (incl. iter42 ghost) + 5 Pixabay clips purged from DB; curated_clips restored to the 3 seeded Cloudinary demos. Minor accessibility console warning on dialog.

minor.issue: `count` is silently clamped to [1,20]; response only surfaces `created` + `source`. Consider echoing the clamped count (and treating count<=0 as 400) for client transparency. Non-blocking.
No validation when ALL three fields are null/absent — call returns 200 with the unmodified account. Harmless but consider 400 'no changes'.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> for a11y.
Edit dialog has NO visible save-state for caption inputs (blur-to-save) — users get no confirmation toast/indicator. Consider a tiny saved-tick.

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> to EditAccountDialog in CuratedAccountManager.jsx to clear Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Add inline saved-tick for caption blur-save so admins see confirmation.
(Optional) 400 instead of 200-no-op when PATCH /api/admin/curated-accounts receives all-null body; echo clamped count from sage-reels response.
No critical fixes required — feature is production-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: CuratedAccountManager.jsx L156-164: saveCaption() silently swallows the server response — update local state from the server-returned caption rather than the input value to ensure trimmed/normalized data is reflected.
server.py L2765: `count = max(1, min(body.count, 20))` silently coerces 0/negative to 1 — differs from create flow which allows populate_count=0. Minor inconsistency.

server.py L2774-2775: Pixabay clips are inserted into db.curated_clips with the raw Pixabay URL and no de-dup — repeat Sage calls on the same category grow the library unboundedly with potential duplicates (same video_url).
No idempotency / rate-limiting on sage-reels — an admin accidentally spamming the button could burn through the Pixabay quota quickly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dialog-open, profile-save, sage-add, caption-blur-save, reel-delete all PASS)

seed_data_creation: Created 1 curated account (TEST_UI_Mgr → TEST_UI_Edited2) + 3 reels via UI; backend pytest fixtures created 1 more curated account with reels. All curated accounts + Pixabay clips purged post-test. db.curated_clips restored to the 3 seeded Cloudinary demos (dog.mp4, sea_turtle.mp4, elephants.mp4). DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clicking the row via Playwright's `page.click(sel, force=True)` did NOT fire the React onClick on first try — had to use `page_handle.click()` (native). Real users are unaffected. For future automation prefer `(await page.query_selector(sel)).click()` for the row trigger. Pixabay key works and returns clips tagged 'royalty-free'. Local-storage auth key: `postmeplex.token`. Dialog uses Radix Dialog and has an a11y warning worth cleaning up.
rca of the issue: N/A — all flows pass. The main agent's noted force-click timing issue is reproducible with Playwright `force=True` on the row <button>; using the element handle's native click resolves it and should be the pattern for future UI harness tests of this dialog.
